# Northwind Pressure-Relief Valve Catalog

Specifications for the HX valve family. All values are fictional test data.

## Valve HX-2291-A

The HX-2291-A pressure-relief valve is rated for a maximum working pressure of 40 bar and a set-point tolerance of plus or minus 1.5 percent. It uses a stainless steel body with a fluoroelastomer seal and must be serviced every 6 months. Replacement seal kits are ordered under kit number K-2291-A.
